component: Calendar logging migration part 3 control flow

quotes.text: throw Error("loadCalendarComponent was called more than once for a single window");

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Part 3 makes a duplicate async Calendar load reject instead of logging and returning. It removes the local savePrefFile catch after setting the sort-order preference, so a throw can skip the ordered-event callback's following selection update. It also stops attachment setup when a cloud provider is absent. The owned attachment function throws synchronously; accepted later async entry points reject and the account-key caller awaits them. These are scoped failure contracts, not proof of durable preference writes, startup recovery or a reproduced failure.
title: Calendar ERROR migration strengthens loader, persistence and attachment failure paths
